traps.label: Two 'Spank Guys' rows with different descriptions: 'at 1pm on the third Saturday of every month' (19 Sept, 17 Oct) and 'at 6.30pm on the first Friday of every month' (2 Oct)
traps.why: Lookalike, not a duplicate: the same group meets on two independent monthly cadences with different times, images and descriptions. Dedup keyed on title + venue must not fold the first-Friday instances into the Saturday series or drop either one.

evidence.quote: The North West CP Group meet in The Eagle at 6.30pm on the first Friday of every month.

expect.note: Both series (and every instance) are expected; the trap is folding them.

traps.label: 'Sunday Service' as named inside other rows: Beareoke 'straight after Sunday Service' and 'Lola Lasagne does Sunday Service with hostess Gladys Duffy'
traps.why: The venue's Sunday-afternoon cabaret has no row of its own on the first page (only the 13 Sept edition with Lola Lasagne is listed, as a titled one-off). 'Sunday Service' must not be split out of the Beareoke description into a separate weekly event.

traps.label: 'EVENT FAQ IS THERE A CLOAK ROOM? ... WHERE DO WE PURCHASE TICKETS? ... tickets ... are normally available on the day from the event entrance' under the list on /eventlist
traps.why: FAQ prose under the widget; no date, no title.

traps.label: Homepage 'EAGLE BAR MANCHESTER IS A PRIVATE MEMBERS CLUB & REQUIRES MEMBERSHIP' / 'MANCHESTERS MEN ONLY MEMBERS BAR' and its 'UPCOMING EVENTS' heading over an Instagram embed
traps.why: Outside the parser's urls. The homepage's 'UPCOMING EVENTS' section is an Instagram feed ('Follow us on Instagram #wix @wix Load More'), not an events widget; the membership banner is a venue notice.

traps.label: Price ranges and tiers: Locker Room £8-£10, Hanky Panky £5-£8, Hellbent £6-£8, Ultimate00s £3-£5, Suck My Disco 'Early Bird (Before 11:30pm) £5.00 / Advance Only £8.00'
traps.why: Wix ticketing tiers inside one event; the early-bird cutoff (11:30pm) is not a second start time.

traps.label: Rows whose location.name is the bare word 'Manchester' (Spank Guys Saturdays, Ultimate00s) or 'Eagle Bar Manchester' (Hanky Panky, Collared, Hellbent, Suck My Disco) instead of 'The Eagle Bar'
traps.why: Three spellings of the one venue, all with the same address and geocode. 'Manchester' read as a bar name would geocode to the city; the address line '15 Bloom St, Manchester M1 3HZ, UK' is the constant.

expect.note: The events are expected; the trap is treating the three names as three venues.
